premises.text: Integrating Web3 turns game economies into real economies requiring Federal Reserve-like management
premises.evidence_span: as soon as you build a web 3 game Your game economy becomes a real economy so the way that you thought about a game economy and the way that you tuned your game economy to You know be more entertaining or engaging to players all of all those lessons that you learn go out the window because all of a sudden, you know, you need to think like the Federal Reserve managing the US economy

premises.text: Marketing spend and one-dimensional staking are insufficient to keep Web3 game economies healthy
premises.evidence_span: they would take the money that they raised from their NFT sales and just spend it on marketing to new players to bring new players into the ecosystem

premises.text: Two principles: participants must be able to produce; taxes create currency value
premises.evidence_span: the people who are participating in the economy should be able to produce in that economy. And the second principle is that there should be, you know, taxes create value

premises.text: Moonstream supplies on-chain production features, rewards, leaderboards, and security bots
premises.evidence_span: we have on-chain minigames, on-chain crafting, Minecraft style. We allow games to deliver rewards to their players for activities that they do. We have leaderboards that incentivize players to act in a healthy manner inside the economy. And we run security bots
